name: Mercor
work: Expert contract work for AI labs: evaluating and writing AI training data in fields like software, law, medicine, finance and languages.

availability.note: Mercor says it does not engage contractors in countries outside its supported list. Each job listing can also name its own eligible countries, so check the listing too.

items.text: Each listing can set its own eligible countries. If a listing names none, Mercor's default is reported to be the US, Canada, the UK and the EU, but language listings are often open more widely.
Applying involves an AI interview, and one interview is reused across listings.
Stripe is reported to be the main payout method, with Wise used in a few countries. PayPal is reported not to be offered.
Top rates for expert work are reported to be higher than on many similar platforms.
Old copies of Mercor's country list still circulate online and include countries the live page no longer lists. Always check the live page before applying.
